title: Arcane Library Ritual
description: A purple-haired sorceress in a dark blue robe and red gloves stands at a marble counter, examining a glowing green spellbook emitting purple energy. Behind her, a large glass display case contains a luminous blue potion bottle, an unrolled scroll with text, and various magical artifacts, with red candles, an open book, and dripping red wax visible on the counter.
prompt: A sorceress with long purple hair tied back with a blue ribbon, wearing a dark blue robe with gold trim and bright red gloves, stands in a gothic fantasy study with purple walls and arched ceilings. She holds a glowing green book emitting purple magical energy. To her left is a tall glass display case containing a large glowing blue potion bottle with swirling designs, an unrolled scroll, and other magical items. Red candles drip blood-red wax onto a white marble counter where an open ancient book lies. Crystal lanterns hang from the ceiling and framed portraits adorn the walls.
